info.name: RAEN x402 Fleet — 12 pay-per-call APIs on Base
info.description:
One-click import: run every RAEN x402 API from Postman (also works in Insomnia and Bruno via OpenAPI import).

**How x402 works:** paid endpoints return HTTP 402 with a base64 `payment-required` header containing a signed challenge. Click any paid request WITHOUT paying — you get the challenge for free. Settle it with an x402 client (USDC on Base, eip155:8453), then resend with the `X-PAYMENT` header to get the real result.

Free first call on royal-ruby (charge-and-rebate, net $0): https://bshelby88.github.io/raen-first-call-free/
Interactive docs: https://raen-api-docs.vercel.app/  •  MCP gateway: https://raen-mcp-gateway.fly.dev/mcp (Bearer-gated)
Operator: Royal Agentic Enterprises (RAEN) — ops@royalruby.io
